lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Forge is lit, the convoy's a story people tell now, and the Overload trainer's by the carrier where he always is.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Go and sit with him. He doesn't explain twice. He barely explains once, so bring somebody who writes things down.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Forge has been lit twenty years. Longer, if you count my mother's, and I do count my mother's.
